summary: This bill mandates the Internal Revenue Service to modernize its services by establishing a public dashboard for real-time information on call volumes and wait times, expanding electronic access for taxpayers to view their tax return and refund information, and enhancing online accounts to allow taxpayers and their authorized representatives to view and respond to IRS documents.

scores.thoughts: This bill mandates the IRS to implement several technological improvements and expansions of services, such as a real-time dashboard, expanded electronic access to tax information, callback technology, and online accounts. These new requirements will necessitate government expenditure for development, implementation, and maintenance, thus increasing government spending.

The bill focuses on improving the taxpayer experience and modernizing IRS services, which could indirectly make tax compliance easier. However, it does not directly alter tax rates, deductions, credits, or the overall tax burden on individuals or corporations. Its impact on taxation is therefore indirect and minor.
